basic_info.description: A+ location in Rincon Hill! Welcome to this gorgeous high-floor 1BD/1BA plus office nook with 10 ft floor-to-ceiling windows facing south! Sunny all day long! You will enjoy the panoramic views of city/mountain from all rooms! The Harrison building redefines the luxury! You will be impressed by the sophiscated, modern lobby at the first glance. The best finishes complete this roomy unit, with custom lighting, Oak plank flooring, custom cabinetry, Waterworks copper fixers, Bertazzoni 4-burner gas range, Sub-Zero built-in refrigerator, and Carrara marble countertops. Parking and extra storage space included! The Harrison is renowned for its five-star amenities and top-of-the-line services, including 24/7 front desk, full time concierge, on-site maintenance team, valet parking, fitness center, outdoor heated pool and spa, self-storage and personal wine storage, daily fresh coffee and breakfast bakery, and the famous Uncle Harry's sky lounge with bars on the 49th floor overlooking Bay Bridge.
